disposition_reason: Only the legacy registered-runtime manifest is present under this public task. It declares a complete programme, but its executor/scorer paths point to unavailable authoring trees; recover the exact pinned source and validate native masked trajectories before any runnable claim.

scientific_target.question: At fixed 0,5,10-second calibration budgets, does a prespecified recalibration procedure improve later-session velocity prediction beyond its unchanged decoder and clock-only control?
scientific_target.known_answer: Seven OpenLoopKinematicsVelocity supervision channels at the source evaluation mask, and paired recalibrated-minus-unchanged R² at each fixed budget.
scientific_target.answer_origin: FALCON H1 NWB source velocity labels, trial boundaries and evaluation mask; these are the source open-loop supervision trajectories, not proof of measured executed hand motion.
scientific_target.case_unit: Complete later recording run with ordered masked 20-ms prediction bins; runs nested within source session.
scientific_target.independent_unit: One human participant; session-level repetition is not new biological replication.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Within-person temporal/session transfer of source velocity-label prediction; source-label reconstruction can be a valid predictive endpoint but does not show motor intention mechanism or independent-person transfer.
exclusions: Official hidden FALCON challenge performance from this public development package.
Causal motor mechanism or unaided neural interpretation from programme scores.

inputs: NWB unit spike times binned to source kinematic endpoints at the pinned 20-ms policy, with declared unit/channel order.
Declared trial-boundary/timing context, training labels and exact 0/5/10-second calibration prefixes; compare neural_clock with clock_only.
forbidden_inputs: Query OpenLoopKinematicsVelocity and derived kinematic proxies.
Future neural bins, query labels outside calibration, feedback or 067/068 cross-task target reuse.
observation_contract.case_identity: Legacy manifest declares 14 later runs × two arms × three calibration budgets = 84 contexts. Exact prepared public case roster and source-ID binding are absent.
observation_contract.split: Use source H1 session held-in/held-out mapping and complete run boundaries. Calibration prefixes must precede the scored suffix; no random-bin splits or shared target-session fitting beyond the declared budget.
observation_contract.coverage: The manifest declares complete scope, not actual source ingestion or scored completion. All declared runs/arms/budgets must be recovered; labels/conditions do not add benchmarks.

primary.name: Paired later-session variance-weighted R² gain at each fixed calibration budget
primary.aggregation: Prospective binding to the pinned official H1 evaluator: mask bins, combine sets within source session, compute variance-weighted multichannel R² per session, then equal sessions. Pair each calibrated prediction with the identical unchanged-decoder target suffix; report each budget separately.
primary.rationale: Preserves the official session and multichannel weighting rather than inflating support with correlated bins or averaging individual coordinate R² arbitrarily.

secondary: Per-session and per-channel errors, constant-target dispositions and complete masked row count.
Calibration cost, causal latency and neural_clock minus clock_only gain at each budget.

comparators.name: Frozen source sklearn decoder
comparators.inputs: Same causal spikes and permitted training/calibration labels.
comparators.procedure: Prospective independently frozen official example decoder; its exact source/runtime must be restored and qualified.

comparators.name: Clock-only and neural shuffle
comparators.inputs: Same allowed trial/time history; shuffled training spike associations for the neural null.
comparators.procedure: Prospective matched information controls; the current manifest does not deliver verifiable numerical execution.

comparators.name: Unchanged decoder
comparators.inputs: Same later-session inputs and score suffix, no new calibration fitting.
comparators.procedure: Freeze once before later sessions; compare to each predeclared calibrated recipe, never select the best budget after scoring.

nuisance_controls: Audit timestamp rate/offset semantics against actual NWB version before spike bins are aligned.
Keep within-session set dependence and temporal drift; no bin-level independence assumption.
Remove query kinematics and future samples, record all permitted target-batch adaptation.
Resolve shared source and label exposure between067 and068.
evaluation.uncertainty: One participant: descriptive paired session/run-block variation only; source sessions are dependent and no human-population confidence interval is justified.
evaluation.failure_policy: Prospectively require exact complete ordered row IDs, seven finite outputs and all masks/contexts; retain failures and undefined constant targets instead of zero/perfect score or dropped runs. Current public source does not implement this admission.

implementation.scorer_target: No scorer body is delivered in this task package. The manifest describes a combined all84-context execution/trusted grading interface with a constant-target successor; a declaration cannot establish its numerical behavior.
implementation.delivered_scope: A pinned legacy declaration only; referenced authoring executor, source freeze and external review paths are not present in this public checkout.
missing: Recover exact referenced executor/scorer and source membership artifacts with valid provenance.
Validate full NWB timestamp/mask/channel/target joins and source terms.
Execute complete fixed comparator and causal boundary controls under the exact declared scope.
implementation.execution_evidence: Manifest explicitly declares not_run, execution_selected=false and runtime/scientific qualification false. This revision inspected public source declarations and official loader/metric source; no authentic payload or model run.

direct_observation.representation: A fixed neural observation packet with channel/time/coordinate units and the same declared calibration support, answered without execution.
direct_observation.boundary: No evaluator targets, source-label lookup, other-case memory or model/numerical tools; a direct response is evaluated separately from programme results.
missing: Authentic complete observation presentation and no-tools response collection have not been delivered.

typed_viewer.representation: Proposed typed navigation over the permitted neural observation, with units and calibration examples.
typed_viewer.boundary: Only rendered allowed observations; no raw target arrays or unrestricted filesystem/code access. A plot alone does not establish viewer execution.
missing: Task-specific renderer/action API, complete case collection and restrictive transport are absent.

tool_assisted.representation: Case-local numerical/model-assisted investigation under a fixed observation and compute entitlement.
tool_assisted.boundary: Current query inspection may inform an allowed proposal; fit/selection remains training-only and evaluator outcomes are inaccessible. Fresh case state is required.
missing: A legacy manifest or prediction scorer does not deliver the participant investigation runtime.

frozen_program.representation: Precommitted source, fitting/adaptation recipe and complete prediction output contract.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze before query access; equal declared calibration and no post-query selection from evaluator feedback. Programme success does not measure unaided interpretation.
missing: No executable participant programme is present in the assigned package.

title: Recalibration benefit under intracortical drift

evidence.supports: Preserved source identity, original endpoint, allowed observations and unresolved source/qualification limits.
Only delivered implementation artifact: full declared scope and absent/unselected execution qualification.

evidence.locator: Pinned load_nwb H1 branch and bin_units
evidence.supports: H1 consumes OpenLoopKinematicsVelocity, trial changes and eval_mask; 20-ms spike binning requires exact selected timestamp semantics.
Official source groups sets by session and reports mean variance-weighted multichannel R² after masking.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: No task-specific solver result is established by the inspected package. The repository historical programme pilot remains confined to NEURAL-007 and NEURAL-077; no result transfers here.
excluded_claims: Official hidden FALCON challenge performance from this public development package.
Causal motor mechanism or unaided neural interpretation from programme scores.

summary: Expose that the public package is a manifest-only partial delivery, not an executable scorer.
Bind prospective metrics to source session/mask/multichannel semantics and restrict inference to one-person source-label transfer.
Separate budget-wise recalibration gains from unchanged and clock-only comparators.
revision.source_review: Inspected the original registration and the actual public implementation files listed in evidence. Primary official sources were checked where needed; historical execution declarations remain scoped, not promoted.
